metric_definitions.main_score: Pooled B = 50 * sum(delivered + on_time) / sum(input parcels).
metric_definitions.scoring_a: Pooled completion, then on-time service rate only on exact completion ties.
metric_definitions.ranking: Exact Fraction competition co-ranks (1,2,2,4); B has no distance tiebreak.
metric_definitions.sa_point_estimate: Equal mean of five seed-level pooled results; input parcels counted once.
metric_definitions.sa_rng: One seeded stream within each one-day simulation; seed reset for each new day.
metric_definitions.sa_scoring_a: Mean selected-scope delivered total, then mean on-time total, at the common input denominator.
metric_definitions.utilisation: Within a policy/seed, sum departure loads / (capacity * sum trips); SA reports the mean of seed utilisations.
metric_definitions.undefined: Undefined utilisation is null; seed statistics omit null observations.
metric_definitions.daily_outcomes: Paired same-day comparisons; SA uses its expected mean daily credit/counts, not seed win totals.
metric_definitions.scope_caution: All20 includes development cases; evaluation006-020 is reported separately. Seed replications are not independent input days.

sa_settings.objective: raw route service credit: on-time 1, early/late 0.5
sa_settings.best_route_rule: greatest credit, then least full-trip distance; seed included
sa_settings.neighbourhood: uniform random swap of two distinct parcel positions
sa_settings.membership: fixed within each trip; constructor called fresh per dispatch
sa_settings.random_stream: dedicated random.Random(seed), initialised once per run
